caption: The drawing depicts a semi-circular lace collar rendered in fine black lines on a light background. The collar is composed of a single piece with a curved inner edge and a wider, scalloped outer edge. Decorative patterns are distributed symmetrically along the collar, featuring repeated motifs of small floral clusters connected by curved, vine-like lines. The edge of the collar is bordered by a delicate, repeating lace pattern. The drawing is framed by a simple rectangular border, and there is a rectangular label in the bottom right corner with the text "MARIE FOUMI-LAPA" inside. Additional small, hand-written text is visible at the bottom right outside the border. The overall color of the drawing is monochrome, using shades of black or gray on a white or off-white paper.
title: Collar
